newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Hungary's Goncz recalls time in prison.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's Goncz recalls time in prison.

text.p: Hungarian President Arpad Goncz began an official visit to boost trade with Argentina on Monday with an emotional reference to being sent to jail after the 1956 uprising against the former Soviet Union.
Goncz spoke after receiving an honorary decoration from Argentina's Peronist Party President Carlos Menem, who was also a prisoner for part of the 1976-1983 rule of the military juntas.
"The president (Menem) and I have had parallel experiences," Goncz told reporters, "As he had to pass through a prison due to his fight for democracy and I also went to jail in 1956."

Goncz, who will meet Menem again on Tuesday before leaving for neighboring Paraguay on Wednesday, remarked on the similarities between the recent histories of Argentina and Hungary, which are both consolidating young democracies.
Both countries also face the challenge of consolidating troubled economies, he said.
